items.description: Non-transferable means that the token may be restricted from transferring.
Such accounts means your tokens may be frozen, resulting in potential asset loss.
Closable permissions mean that token contracts can be closed, which will result in your token holdings being erased.
Mintable function means token total supply can be increased, which may affect token price.
Balance manipulation was found, which means developers can transfer funds without approval to manipulate user balance.
The token was deployed by a high-risk address, which may be associated with fraud, exploits, or other malicious activities.
The token's name, symbol, and other details can be changed, potentially misleading or scamming users.
This token is associated with hacking incident, hackers may gain control over this contract.
Modified tax means tax rate can be changed and may affect the cost to the user when buying and selling.
A honeypot is a token that can be bought but not sold, and users will suffer asset losses after buying it.
Unusual buy tax means users will pay a high tax and receive fewer tokens when buying.
Unusual sell tax means users will pay a high tax and receive fewer tokens when selling.
Low liquidity means that there is no or a small liquidity pool, resulting in failure to swap or large slippage.
Rug pull means that relevant funds may be withdrawn suddenly, leaving users with worthless tokens.
A fake token has no real value and may deceive users into believing it is a valuable asset.
A scam address may be associated with fraud, Ponzi schemes, or other malicious activities. Users should conduct extra verification before transactions.
A spam token has no real value and may be airdropped to deceive users into believing it is a valuable asset.
Wash trade refers to artificially inflated trading volumes, making the data fail to show true market demand.
